def update(self, forecasts, observations):
        """
        Update the statistics with forecasts and observations.

        Args:
            forecasts: The discrete Cumulative Distribution Functions of
            observations:
        """
        self.forecasts = forecasts
        self.observations = observations
        self.forecast_counts = np.bincount(forecasts, minlength=self.num_bins)
        self.observation_counts = np.bincount(observations, minlength=self.num_bins)
        self.forecast_probabilities = self.forecast_counts / np.sum(self.forecast_counts)
        self.observation_probabilities = self.observation_counts / np.sum(self.observation_counts)
        self.forecast_cumulative_probabilities = np.cumsum(self.forecast_probabilities)
        self.observation_cumulative_probabilities = np.cumsum(self.observation_probabilities)
